verdict.rationale: PayPal documents that agent-originated orders flow into the merchant's existing order management system "just as it would from any other channel," with standard webhooks, refund/dispute tools (create_refund, list_disputes, accept_dispute_claim) and transaction-detail APIs supporting reconciliation, and no separate fee schedule for agentic transactions — reinforcing that settlement rides existing PayPal/Braintree payout rails. However, this is caveated by narrow scope (Store Sync limited to US physical goods), gated onboarding (form approval required, Braintree/Google enablement prerequisites), and no explicit documentation of a dedicated payout/settlement report or reconciliation guide specific to agent-channel transactions. Missing for 10: a documented payout/settlement report tagging agent-originated transactions, independent merchant confirmation that reconciliation works in practice, and coverage beyond the narrow Store Sync eligibility criteria.
